title: A glance dashboard no component can do: the right answer is a request, not script
prompt: Build a glance dashboard that answers "is everything okay?": one row each for "Baby" (sleeping), "Package" (en route) and "Server" (up). Each row shows a label, a state (ok, warn or bad, not given by color alone) and a short detail line. The values arrive in a <ui-store> and the rows must update live when the store changes, with no script. If the library's components cannot do this, do NOT write inline script or onclick handlers. Instead write a request for a new component (request.md): what is missing, why no existing component can do it, and the proposed tag with its attributes, events, slots and CSS custom properties, following CLAUDE.md.
